title: How many SETS a week to grow a muscle? 📅
caption:
Studies pooled: 10+ hard sets per muscle a week grew more than fewer than 5. Beginners grow on less. How many sets do you do per muscle? 👇

Muscle Building, Part 3
first_comment: Sets per muscle per week: what's your number? 📅
sources: Schoenfeld BJ, Ogborn D, Krieger JW. Dose-response relationship between weekly resistance training volume and increases in muscle mass: a systematic review and meta-analysis. J Sports Sci 2017;35:1073-1082 (10+ sets/week > 5-9 > <5)
Baz-Valle E et al. A systematic review of the effects of different resistance training volumes on muscle hypertrophy. J Hum Kinet 2022;81:199-210
